items.description: Leak detection and bathroom wall opening
items.rationale: The indoor supply-pipe fracture is insured under §1.1, and §2.1 covers both locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at €110 gross total €220.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers repair of the fractured pipe. Allow €170 gross for fitting the short replacement section and €40 gross for copper and fittings.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile the 0.2 m² patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their prior condition. Allow €250 gross for small-job labour and €45 gross for materials, limited to the invoiced patch.

items.description: Annual gas boiler service and descaling
items.rationale: Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, so the indemnity threshold is zero. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.
